div.p: An optional child element of appraisal, biogHist, custodHist, processInfo, and sourceOfAcquisition used to record a timeline of activities in the history of the materials being described or the biography of the records creator.

Use provenanceEvent to record an activity in the creation, management and ongoing maintenance of the materials being described or in the history of the records creator. This may include activities of appraisal and selection, sensitivity review, revisions, updates, retentions, etc.

The type of each event may be defined with the attribute localType. Use localTypeDeclarationReference to refer to a localTypeDeclaration within control where you have defined those types. The child eventDateTime to record when the event took place is mandatory, while the child agent to provide information about who or what carried out, or was otherwise responsible for, the activity is optional, though highly recommended. Furthermore, the information about the event may be described in eventDescription.
